title: Identity-Aware BiLSTM-GRU Toxicity Classifier
summary: Comments are lowercased and tokenized with a word/punctuation regex. A vocabulary of the 120,000 most frequent training tokens is built only from training text; sequences are head-truncated to 220 tokens, with padding and unknown-token IDs. The model learns 300-dimensional embeddings with channel-wise spatial dropout, followed by a bidirectional LSTM and bidirectional GRU. Max and masked mean pools from both recurrent outputs are concatenated, passed through a residual ReLU/dropout dense block, and projected to toxicity plus one logit per identity label. Training uses length-bucketed shuffled batches, AdamW, mixed precision with gradient scaling, gradient-norm clipping, and epoch-wise multiplicative learning-rate decay. The primary binary cross-entropy is sample-weighted to emphasize identity examples and toxicity/identity subgroup cases; auxiliary identity BCE is added equally. At inference, toxicity probabilities are sigmoid outputs from the main logit, averaged across the final two epoch snapshots.
